scope: existing set_model/set_thinking shapes over local-owner async IPC; production runtime remains disabled
admission: native command_pi: local owner, current stream/cwd and approved directory identity, ready, supported capability, no pending query/configuration or owned run
applied: only after correlated mutation acknowledgement plus correlated get_state readback persisted into session state
readback: applied empty response does not echo the requested model/level; clients use authoritative session state and ignore obsolete session/fence results
unknown: missing/failed readback, timeout or closed receiver never becomes rejected/applied; no automatic retry
responsiveness: health, subscription events, list_models rejection, close and disconnect remain responsive while a mutation is pending
